subject: Input restriction in idd model for effects sum 0.

messages.author: da63f9ca4e626114
messages.subject: Input restriction in idd model for effects sum 0.
parts:
Hi team,
ha have a small example of random model, listed below;

data <- expand.grid(Ped=1,G=1:5,rep=1:2)
data <- rbind(data,expand.grid(Ped=2,G=6:10,rep=1:2))
data$Y <- rnorm(nrow(data))

library(INLA)
formula <- Y~f(Ped,model="iid")+f(G,model="iid")
m1 <- inla(formula,data=data)

summary(m1)
m1$summary.random


I need input restrict for G factor are where sum of effects for each Ped (Secound term) is equal to 0, is possibile put this restriction?
Thanks 
Éder Silva
